new_candidates.body:
Hi team — we ran a limited QC pass over `demo_data/` — the entire tree, all 20 parquet files (7,288 rows total; every file pulled through the LFS batch API and SHA-256-verified before analysis). This covers the demo tree only; it says nothing about larger training datasets. Results:

**No issues found in the checks listed below:**
- NaN/Inf in `observation.state` / `action`: **0**
- `episode_index` monotonicity: OK in all files
- `index` / `frame_index` continuity: **0 gaps**
- timestamp dt uniformity vs the fps declared in `meta/info.json`: `cube_to_bowl_5` (30 fps), `libero_demo` (20 fps), `simplerenv_bridge_sample` (5 fps) — all clean. Every number above is recomputable from the parquet files and their `meta/info.json`.

Two notes where a naive check would misfire (both our own errors, kept here in case they save someone time):
- `simplerenv_fractal_sample`: declared `fps=3` in `meta/info.json`, observed dt = 0.3333 s uniformly — **consistent**. We first flagged this by assuming 5 fps from the sibling bridge sample; the metadata was right, our inherited assumption was wrong. A fps-inheritance check across sibling samples would false-positive here.
- `cube_to_bowl_5` cells at exactly |100.0|: consistent with SO100 joint limits in degrees and with `meta/stats.json` — not a defect.

**One minor schema observation:**
- `demo_data/droid_sample/meta/info.json` declares `fps: 15`, but its parquet schema carries no `timestamp` / `frame_index` / `index` features, while the other four samples do. So for the DROID sample there is no per-frame ground truth to check frame timing or video sync against — fps has to be taken on trust. If it came through an older export path, re-exporting it with the same writer as the other samples would make the demo suite schema-uniform.

**Offer:** we maintain a small deterministic QC utility for LeRobot-format robotics datasets (NaN/bounds, episode and index continuity, dt-vs-declared-fps; pandas + pyarrow only). The same kind of checks previously surfaced real defects in public robotics datasets — unnormalized quaternions in AgiBot-World ([OpenDriveLab/AgiBot-World#164](https://github.com/OpenDriveLab/AgiBot-World/issues/164), independently confirmed to the digit by a third party) and unit-semantics gaps in PaXini's px-omnisharing kit ([px-DataCollection/px_omnisharing_dataprocess_kit#3](https://github.com/px-DataCollection/px_omnisharing_dataprocess_kit/issues/3)). Happy to contribute the utility under `scripts/` (or wherever you prefer) — glad to open a PR on your sign-off.

— PHM-Audit
new_candidates.title: QC pass over demo_data (20/20 parquet, SHA-256-verified) + utility offer

#### Tuning / Configuration Goal
I just want to run nav2 with my behavior trees. Right now I'm using default ones from nav2_bt_navigator that I copied to my project. I modified nav2_params file to look like this:
```
bt_navigator:
  ros__parameters:
    global_frame: map
    robot_base_frame: base_link
    odom_topic: /odom
    bt_loop_duration: 10
    default_server_timeout: 20
    wait_for_service_timeout: 1000
    action_server_result_timeout: 900.0
    navigators: ["navigate_to_pose", "navigate_through_poses"]
    navigate_to_pose:
      plugin: "nav2_bt_navigator::NavigateToPoseNavigator"
    navigate_through_poses:
      plugin: "nav2_bt_navigator::NavigateThroughPosesNavigator"
    default_nav_to_pose_bt_xml: >
      $(find-pkg-share diff_drive_robot_navigation)/behavior_trees/navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml

    default_nav_through_poses_bt_xml: >
      $(find-pkg-share diff_drive_robot_navigation)/behavior_trees/navigate_through_poses_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml

    error_code_names:
      - compute_path_error_code
      - follow_path_error_code
```
But when I try to launch nav2 with this params I get this error:
```
[bt_navigator-6] [ERROR] [1794106364.128418991] [bt_navigator]: Couldn't open input XML file: /home/winet/Documents/dvbot_ws/install/diff_drive_robot_navigation/share/diff_drive_robot_navigation/behavior_trees/navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml
[bt_navigator-6] 
[bt_navigator-6] [ERROR] [1794106364.128530911] [bt_navigator]: Error loading XML file: /home/winet/Documents/dvbot_ws/install/diff_drive_robot_navigation/share/diff_drive_robot_navigation/behavior_trees/navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_recovery.xml
```
But file exists in this directory with this exact name, it is correct (groot can open it and its literally unmodified default nav2 tree) and permissions for files are correct.
#### What I've Tried
I tried to hardcode path to files and I tried using "RewrittenYaml" but it didn't help. Here is the link to the package in question: https://github.com/wineTGH/diff_drive_robot_navigation

Please, help me. I'm loosing my mind over this cryptic error message
